note: All photos are from the test split: the YOLO11n model never saw them in training. labels are the AMI expert labels; groups simplify them to moth / not a moth / unknown. sources marks who drew each box: 'ami' = the AMI experts, 'team' = boxes and labels our team added or decided on the lesson photos ('Unidentifiable' boxes we could judge). unlisted = spots that are not scored either way (specks, dust, the printed scale card, mites, insects cut off at the edge).
